args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
args.body:
- Newsletter: Ironbark Tooling's latest newsletter covers cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to a feature article and a companion piece (free email registration).
- Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: Pilots cut claims by a quarter.
